<function name="GetBoneContents" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns the contents of the specified bone.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="bone" type="number">The bone id, starting at index 0. See <page>Entity:LookupBone</page>.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">The contents as a <page>Enums/CONTENTS</page> or 0 on failure.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
